data.name: Escape the Flood!
data.detailed_description:
The water is already at your ankles.

You wash ashore on a sinking island. The ocean climbs, the beach goes first, and the ground disappears under you one stretch at a time. Gather what the island gives you, build something that floats, and be on it when there is nothing left to stand on.

  • A new island every round. Terrain and resources are randomly generated. Nothing to memorize, every start a cold start.

  • Short, brutal rounds. Long enough to lose everything, short enough to immediately try again.

  • Chop, mine, haul, craft. Nothing you need is in one place, and the tideline eats the ground behind you while you fetch it.

  • Stay above the water. Oxygen runs out fast, and the island has no shallow end left.

  • Solo or co-op. Split the island, cover more ground, revive each other.

  • The captain decides when to sail. First one aboard holds the wheel. Wait for the others, or leave them on the rock.

  • Proximity voice chat. You hear whoever is close. Everything else is out of earshot.

  • Axe, pickaxe, spear, fists. All of them work on other players too.

A finite amount of island. Everything else is up to you.

data.short_description: A first person survival crafting game with a deadline. The ocean is rising, the procedurally generated island is going under, and your only way out is a boat you have not built yet. Escape alone, or with up to three others.
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 / Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU (Metal)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon only. Intel-based Macs are not supported.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma or newer
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M2 or newer)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 integrated GPU (Metal) or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.5 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-capable GPU with 4 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support required.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 / Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
